verdict.rationale: A state business-filing portal could plausibly offer registrable webhooks for filing or entity-status events, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no outbound HTTP callbacks. The only notification evidence is a voter ballot-tracking feature, which is a consumer notification service, not a webhook a programmatic consumer can register and receive. Probes also found no API spec (OpenAPI paths all 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
